```{r}
# clean financial capital variables

# SNAP participation
url <- "https://www.census.gov/data-tools/demo/saipe_treemap/snap.2023.json"
x <- fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE)

g <- function(v) if (is.null(v)) NA_character_ else as.character(v)
rows <- list()
for (region in x$children) {
for (state in region$children) {
for (county in state$children) {
rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
region = g(region$name),
state = g(state$name),
state_abbrev = g(state$abbrev),
state_fips = g(state$fips),
county = g(county$name),
totalpop = g(county$totalpop),
snappop = g(county$snappop),
snap_pct = g(county$ratio)
)
}
}
}
snap <- do.call(rbind, rows)

nrow(snap) # should be roughly 3,100+ counties
head(snap)
sum(is.na(snap$snap_pct))

write.csv(snap, "snap_2023_county.csv", row.names = FALSE)

f_snap <- snap |>
  select(state, county, snap_pct) |>
  rename(County = county,
         State = state) |>
   mutate(County = str_remove(County, ",.*$"),
          County = str_remove(County, " County"),
          snap_pct = as.numeric(snap_pct))

# owner occupied units
f_housing <- f_housing |>
  separate(County, into = c("County", "State"), sep = ",") |>
  mutate(
    County = str_remove(County, " County"),
    Measure = if_else(
      County %in% c("Estimate", "Margin of Error"),
      County,
      NA_character_
    ),
    County = if_else(
      is.na(Measure),
      County,
      NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  fill(County, State) |>
  filter(Measure == "Estimate") |>
  select(-Measure)

f_housing$County <- iconv(
  f_housing$County,
  from = "",
  to = "UTF-8",
  sub = ""
) 

f_housing <- f_housing |>
  select(-renter_occupied, -total)

# median_hh_income
f_income <- f_income |>
  separate(County, into = c("County", "State"), sep = ",") |>
  mutate(
    County = str_remove(County, " County")
    ) |>
  filter(County != "Households" & County != "Margin of Error" & County != "Families" & County != "Married-couple families" & County != "Nonfamily households") |>
  mutate(County = if_else(County == "Estimate", NA_character_, County)) |>
  fill(County, State) |>
  filter(!is.na(median_hh_income)) |>
  group_by(County, State) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() 

f_income$County <- iconv(
  f_income$County,
  from = "",
  to = "UTF-8",
  sub = ""
) 

# population
f_pop <- f_pop |>
  separate(County, into = c("County", "State"), sep = ",") |>
  mutate(
    County = str_remove(County, " County"),
    County = str_remove(County, "^\\.")
    )
f_pop$County <- iconv(
  f_pop$County,
  from = "",
  to = "UTF-8",
  sub = ""
) 

# poverty
f_poverty |>
  filter(Year == 2024) |>
  head(20)

# vehicle availability
f_vehicle_avail <- f_vehicle_avail |>
  filter(str_detect(`Label (Grouping)`, "No vehicle")) |>
  slice(1) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -`Label (Grouping)`,
    names_to = "County",
    values_to = "Estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(County = str_remove(County, "!!Estimate")) |>
  separate(
    County,
    into = c("County", "State"),
    sep = ", "
  ) |>
  mutate(County = str_remove(County, " County")) |>
  rename(num_no_vehicle = Estimate) |>
  select(State, County, num_no_vehicle)
```

```{r}
# voter turnout (2024) - presidential election

# get CVAP (Citizen Voting Age Population) estimates by county
p_cvap <- p_cvap |>
  filter(lntitle == "Total") |>
  select(geoname, cvap_est) |>
  rename(County = geoname) |>
  separate(County, into = c("County", "State"), sep = ",") |>
  mutate(County = str_remove(County, " County"),
         State = str_trim(State))
  
p_voting <- p_voting |>
  filter(year == 2024) |>
  mutate(
    State = str_to_title(state),
    County = str_to_title(county_name)
  ) |>
  select(State, County, totalvotes) |>
  distinct(.keep_all = TRUE)

p_pres_turnout <- left_join(p_cvap, p_voting, by = c("County", "State"))

p_pres <- p_pres_turnout |>
  mutate(pres_voter_turnout = totalvotes/cvap_est)

# census response rates (2020)
p_census_response <- read_csv("decennialrr2020.csv")
county_census_response <- p_census_response |>
  mutate(geo_id = GEO_ID) |>
  separate(GEO_ID, into = c("code", "county_fips"), sep = "US") |>
  filter(str_length(county_fips) == 5)

data(fips_codes)

county_lookup <- fips_codes |>
  mutate(
    county_fips = paste0(state_code, county_code)
  ) |>
  select(
    county_fips,
    County = county,
    State = state_name
  )

census_resp <- left_join(county_census_response, county_lookup, by = "county_fips")

p_census_resp <- census_resp |>
  select(State, County, CRRALL, CMIN, CMAX, CAVG, CMED) |>
  mutate(
    County = str_remove(County, " County"),
         State = str_trim(State)
  )

# political contributions
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)

list.files("~/Desktop/STAT 711/us_states/indiv24", full.names = TRUE)
readLines("~/Desktop/STAT 711/us_states/indiv24/itcont.txt", n = 5)

# 1. See what's inside before extracting
# unzip("indiv24.zip", list = TRUE)

# 2. Extract to a folder (needs several GB of free disk space)
unzip("indiv24.zip", exdir = "fec24")
list.files("fec24")          # confirm the file name; adjust below if it differs

# 3. Column names, hardcoded so you don't need the separate header file
cols <- c("CMTE_ID","AMNDT_IND","RPT_TP","TRANSACTION_PGI","IMAGE_NUM",
          "TRANSACTION_TP","ENTITY_TP","NAME","CITY","STATE","ZIP_CODE",
          "EMPLOYER","OCCUPATION","TRANSACTION_DT","TRANSACTION_AMT",
          "OTHER_ID","TRAN_ID","FILE_NUM","MEMO_CD","MEMO_TEXT","SUB_ID")
nm <- paste0("'", cols, "'", collapse = ", ")

# 4. Aggregate to ZIP level inside DuckDB
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
q <- sprintf("
  SELECT substr(ZIP_CODE, 1, 5)                       AS zip5,
         COUNT(*)                                     AS n_contrib,
         COUNT(DISTINCT NAME || substr(ZIP_CODE,1,5)) AS n_donors_approx,
         SUM(TRY_CAST(TRANSACTION_AMT AS DOUBLE))     AS total_amt
  FROM read_csv('~/Desktop/STAT 711/us_states/indiv24/itcont.txt', delim = '|', header = false,
                names = [%s], quote = '', all_varchar = true,
                ignore_errors = true)
  WHERE ENTITY_TP = 'IND'
    AND (MEMO_CD IS NULL OR MEMO_CD <> 'X')
    AND length(ZIP_CODE) >= 5
  GROUP BY 1", nm)

zip24 <- dbGetQuery(con, q)
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

saveRDS(zip24, "zip24.rds")   # small file; reuse this from now on

political_contrib <- zip24 |>
  rename(zip = zip5)

zip_to_county <- read_csv("zip2county_master_xwalk_2010_2023_tot_ratio_one2one.csv")
zip_to_county <- zip_to_county |>
  rename(county_fips = county)

contrib_1 <- left_join(political_contrib, zip_to_county |> filter(year == 2023), by = "zip")

p_contributions <- left_join(contrib_1, county_lookup, by = "county_fips") |>
  select(State, County, total_amt, n_donors_approx, n_contrib, zip)

p_cont <- p_contributions |>
  mutate(
    County = str_remove(County, " County"),
    State  = str_trim(State)
  ) |>
  group_by(County, State) |>
  summarise(
    total_contribution_value  = sum(total_amt),
    avg_contribution_value    = mean(total_amt),
    median_contribution_value = median(total_amt),
    total_num_contributions   = sum(n_contrib),
    avg_num_contributions     = mean(n_contrib),
    median_num_contributions  = median(n_contrib),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  

```

# Financial Capital

```{r}
# read in data
# from 2021 6/30/2021 reporting
vt_fdic <- read_csv("Summary_Tables_By_State_County_formatted_9_24_2026.csv")
vt_fdic <- vt_fdic |>
  mutate(county = sub(" County, Vermont$", "", County))
vt_fdic <- vt_fdic[-15, ] |>
  select(-`Report Period`, -State, -county)

# 5 year ACS data 2017-2021
vt <- "50"

# population data
vt_pop <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B01003_001",
  state     = vt,
  year      = 2021,
  survey    = "acs5"
) |>
  mutate(County = sub(" County, Vermont$", "", NAME)) |>
  rename(pop = estimate) |>
  select(County, pop)

# owner occupied units
vt_oo_units <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B25081_008",
  state     = vt,
  year      = 2021,
  survey    = "acs5"
) |>
  mutate(County = sub(" County, Vermont$", "", NAME)) |>
  rename(owner_occupied_units = estimate) |>
  select(County, owner_occupied_units)

# household income
vt_hh_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state     = vt,
  year      = 2021,
  survey    = "acs5"
) |>
  mutate(County = sub(" County, Vermont$", "", NAME)) |>
  rename(median_hh_income = estimate) |>
  select(County, median_hh_income)

# 2023 IRS investment interest
vt_investment_interest <- read_csv("23incyvt(Sheet2).csv")

# % in poverty
vt_poverty_2023 <- read_csv("SAIPE_10-07-2026.csv")

vt_poverty_2023 <- vt_poverty_2023 |>
  mutate(County = sub(" County$", "", Name)) |>
  select(County, `Number in Poverty`, `Percent in Poverty`)
  

# % with no vehicle
no_vehicle <- read_csv("ACS_Vehicle_Availability_Boundaries_2580450326519965340.csv")

vt_vehicle_availability <- no_vehicle |>
  filter(State == "Vermont") |>
  mutate(County = sub(" County$", "", Name)) |>
  select(County, `Percent of households with no vehicle available`)

# % receiving SNAP
vt_hh_snap <- read_csv("snap_hh_2016_5yr.csv")

vt_hh_snap <- vt_hh_snap |>
  mutate(County = sub(" County$", "", County)) |>
  select(County, `Percent with SNAP`)

# join together
vt_county_finance_1 <- left_join(vt_pop, vt_oo_units, by = "County")
vt_county_finance_2 <- left_join(vt_county_finance_1, vt_hh_income, by = "County")
vt_county_finance_3 <- left_join(vt_county_finance_2, vt_investment_interest, by = "County")
vt_county_finance_4 <- left_join(vt_county_finance_3, vt_fdic, by = "County") |>
  rename(deposits_per_county = `All Deposits (Millions USD)`)
vt_county_finance_5 <- left_join(vt_county_finance_4, vt_poverty_2023, by = "County")
vt_county_finance_6 <- left_join(vt_county_finance_5, vt_vehicle_availability, by = "County")
vt_county_finance <- left_join(vt_county_finance_6, vt_hh_snap, by = "County")

write_csv(vt_county_finance, "~/Desktop/STAT 711/vt_county_finance.csv")
```

## Do PCA on Financial Capital

```{r}
vt_county_finance <- vt_county_finance |>
  distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE)

vt_financial_1 <- vt_county_finance %>%
  select(
    pop_z_score,
    oou_z_score,
    hh_income_z_score,
    deposits_z_score,
    investment_interest_z_score,
    poverty_z_score,
    vehicle_avail_z_score,
    hh_snap_z_score
  )

pca_finance <- prcomp(
  vt_financial_1,
  center = FALSE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

# results
pca_finance$rotation[, 1]
pca_finance$x
summary(pca_finance)

# see percentiles
vt_county_finance_pca <- vt_county_finance |>
  mutate(
    financial_capital_pca = pca_finance$x[, 1],
    financial_capital_percentile = percent_rank(financial_capital_pca) * 100
  )
```

## Do EFA/CFA on Financial Capital

```{r}
# efa
library(psych)
fa.parallel(vt_financial_1)

efa <- fa(
  vt_financial_1,
  nfactors = 3,
  rotate = "oblimin",   
  fm = "ml"            
)

summary(efa)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
# f&b establishments per state
df <- read_csv("NONEMP2024.NS00NONEMP-2026-10-08T143707.csv")

vt_fb_est_2022 <- df |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(County = sub(" County, Vermont$", "", geographic_area_name_name)) |>
  select(County, number_of_nonemployer_establishments_nestab, nonemployer_sales_value_of_shipments_or_revenue_1_000_nrcptot)

# other manufacturing establishments (non F&B)
non_fb_est_2023 <- read_csv("CBP2023.CB2300CBP-2026-10-08T135110.csv")

vt_county_manu_est <- non_fb_est_2023[40:nrow(non_fb_est_2023), ] |>
   mutate(County = sub(" County, Vermont$", "", `Geographic Area Name (NAME)`))

vt_manu_est <- vt_county_manu_est |>
  select(County, `Number of establishments (ESTAB)`) |>
  group_by(County) |>
  mutate(total_est = sum(`Number of establishments (ESTAB)`)) |>
  distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(County, total_est)
  
# % access to parks (2025)
vt_park_access <- data.frame(
  County = c("Addison", "Bennington", "Caledonia", "Chittenden", "Essex", "Franklin", "Grand Isle", "Lamoille", "Orange", "Orleans", "Rutland", "Washington", "Windham", "Windsor"),
  pct_with_access_to_parks = c(24, 52, 0, 36, 13, 14, 15, 6, 13, 5, 13, 14, 31, 37)
)

# % access to broadband coverage
vt_bb_access <- data.frame(
  County = c("Addison", "Bennington", "Caledonia", "Chittenden", "Essex", "Franklin", "Grand Isle", "Lamoille", "Orange", "Orleans", "Rutland", "Washington", "Windham", "Windsor"),
  pct_with_broadband_access = c(89, 80, 83, 90, 81, 86, 90, 89, 86, 87, 83, 90, 75, 86),
  num_households = c(12789, 11660, 10649, 62185, 2159, 16611, 2734, 9895, 10811, 9994, 21019, 22541, 14629, 21213)
)

# vt wireless coverage
vt_wireless_coverage <- read_csv("vt_fixed_wireless_coverage_2023.csv")

# Vermont County FIPS 
vt_fips <- data.frame(
  county = c("Addison", "Bennington", "Caledonia", "Chittenden", "Essex", 
             "Franklin", "Grand Isle", "Lamoille", "Orange", "Orleans", 
             "Rutland", "Washington", "Windham", "Windsor"),
  county_fip = c("50001", "50003", "50005", "50007", "50009", 
           "50011", "50013", "50015", "50017", "50019", 
           "50021", "50023", "50025", "50027"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

vt_wireless_coverage <- vt_wireless_coverage |>
  mutate("new_block_geoid" = format(block_geoid, scientific = FALSE),
         "county_fip" = str_sub(new_block_geoid, start = 1, end = 5))

# join counties to fips
vt_wireless_coverage <- left_join(vt_wireless_coverage, vt_fips, by = "county_fip")

vt_wireless_coverage <- vt_wireless_coverage |>
  rename(County = county) |>
  group_by(County) |>
  mutate(max_advertised_download_speed = sum(max_advertised_download_speed),
         max_advertised_upload_speed = sum(max_advertised_upload_speed)) |>
  select(County, max_advertised_download_speed, max_advertised_upload_speed) |>
  distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE)
  

# hospitals
vt_hospitals <- read_csv("vt_hospitals.csv") 
vt_hospitals <- clean_names(vt_hospitals) |>
  mutate(County = str_to_title(county_parish)) |>
  filter(hospital_type %like% "Hospital") |>
  group_by(County) |>
  mutate(number_hospitals = n()) |>
  distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
select(County, number_hospitals, hospital_type, hospital_overall_rating)
  
# roads/highways/interstates (FIX OR DON'T INCLUDE)
state_roads <- read_csv("Vehicle_Miles_of_Travel_by_Federal-Aid_Highways,_2000-2024_(VM-3)_20260930.csv")
vt_roads <- state_roads |>
  filter(State == "Vermont" & Year == 2023)

# airports
airports <- read_csv("NTAD_Aviation_Facilities_-1138898284069410957.csv")

# filter to airports only for public use
vt_airports <- airports |>
  filter(STATE_CODE == "VT" & OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE == "PU" & FACILITY_USE_CODE == "PU")  |>
  select(STATE_CODE, CITY, COUNTY_NAME, ARPT_NAME, OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE, LAT_DECIMAL, LONG_DECIMAL, DIST_CITY_TO_AIRPORT) |>
  group_by(COUNTY_NAME) |>
  summarize(airports_per_county = n()) |>
  mutate(County = str_to_title(COUNTY_NAME)) |>
  select(County, airports_per_county)
  

# join together data sets
vt_built_1 <- left_join(vt_fb_est_2022, vt_manu_est, by = "County")
vt_built_2 <- left_join(vt_built_1, vt_park_access, by = "County")
vt_built_3  <- left_join(vt_built_2, vt_bb_access, by = "County")
vt_built_4 <- left_join(vt_built_3, vt_wireless_coverage, by = "County")
vt_built_5 <- left_join(vt_built_4, vt_hospitals, by = "County")
vt_built_6 <- left_join(vt_built_5, vt_airports, by = "County")
vt_built_6 <- vt_built_6 |>
  mutate(airports_per_county = ifelse(is.na(airports_per_county), 0, airports_per_county),
         number_hospitals = ifelse(is.na(number_hospitals), 0, number_hospitals)) |>
  select(-hospital_type, -hospital_overall_rating, -total_est)

write_csv(vt_built_6, "~/Desktop/STAT 711/vt_built_6.csv")

```

## Do PCA on Built Capital

```{r}
pca_built <- prcomp(
  vt_built_6 |> select(-County),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# results
pca_built$rotation[, 1] # loadings (how much each variable contributes to each component (PC1 in this case))
pca_built$x # scores (how strong each variable is in each component)
summary(pca_built)

# see percentiles
vt_county_built_pca <- vt_built_6 |>
  mutate(
    built_capital_pca = pca_built$x[, 1],
    built_capital_percentile = percent_rank(built_capital_pca) * 100
  )
```

## Do EFA/CFA on Built Capital

```{r}
# efa
library(psych)
fa.parallel(vt_built_6 |> select(-County))

efa_2 <- fa(
  vt_built_6,
  nfactors = 3,
  rotate = "oblimin",   
  fm = "ml"            
)
```

# Political Capital

```{r}
# 2025 vermont census participation
vt_census_participation <- data.frame(
  County = c("Addison", "Bennington", "Caledonia", "Chittenden", "Essex", "Franklin", "Grand Isle", "Lamoille", "Orange", "Orleans", "Rutland", "Washington", "Windham", "Windsor"),
  pct_participation = c(65.5, 54.3, 53.5, 73.5, 37.8, 64.7, 45.3, 54.9, 57, 47.9, 56.1, 61.9, 49.5, 54.3)
)

# voter turnout in presidential election 2020
vt_voter_turnout <- data.frame(
  County = c("Addison", "Bennington", "Caledonia", "Chittenden", "Essex", "Franklin", "Grand Isle", "Lamoille", "Orange", "Orleans", "Rutland", "Washington", "Windham", "Windsor"),
  pct_voter_turnout = c(75.9, 67.8, 63.2, 75.2, 83.6, 68.7, 99.6, 79.6, 63.6, 72.9, 72.9, 75.3, 82.8, 82.1)
)

vt_new_voter_turnout <- data.table(
  County = c("Addison", "Bennington", "Caledonia", "Chittenden", "Essex", "Franklin", "Grand Isle", "Lamoille", "Orange", "Orleans", "Rutland", "Washington", "Windham", "Windsor"),
  pct_voter_turnout = c(78, 75, 75, 72, 76, 70, 76, 73, 75, 72, 75, 76, 73, 75)
  
)

# political contributions (value, count, median count) per county (2020-2021)
contributions <- read_csv("ContributionsListDownload101820261643PM__EntityId(in).csv")
vt_political_contributions <- contributions |>
  mutate(political_contribution = parse_number(`Transaction Amount`)) |>
  select(County, political_contribution) |>
  group_by(County) |>
  summarize(total_contribution = sum(political_contribution),
            num_contributions = n(),
            median_value_of_contribution = median(political_contribution))

# join together
vt_political_1 <- left_join(vt_census_participation, vt_voter_turnout, by = "County")
vt_political_2 <- left_join(vt_political_1, vt_political_contributions, by = "County")
vt_political_2 <- vt_political_2 |>
  mutate(total_contribution = ifelse(is.na(total_contribution), 0, total_contribution),
         num_contributions = ifelse(is.na(num_contributions), 0, num_contributions),
         median_value_of_contribution = ifelse(is.na(median_value_of_contribution), 0, median_value_of_contribution))

write_csv(vt_political_2, "~/Desktop/STAT 711/vt_political_2.csv")
```

## Do PCA on Political Capital

```{r}
pca_political_1 <- prcomp(
  vt_political_2 |> select(-County, - total_contribution),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)
pca_political_2 <- prcomp(
  vt_political_2 |> select(-County),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)
pca_political
pca_political_2$rotation[, 1]
pca_political_2$x


# loadings and scores
pca_political$rotation[, 1]
pca_political$x
as.tibble(pca_political$x) |>
  mutate(County = vt_political_2$County, .before = 1) |>
  arrange(PC1)

summary(pca_political)

vt_political_2 |>
  pivot_longer(-County) |>
  group_by(name) |>
  mutate(mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(sds = round(((value - mean)/sd),2))
```
